questions.question: Can petabase-scale mining of public sequencing archives via translated RdRP search reveal a vast hidden RNA-virus diversity that is absent from curated viral reference databases?
questions.rationale: The 5.7M-run / 10.2 PB upstream search yields ~131,957 candidate novel sOTUs whose representatives drop below the 0.40 identity threshold against curated references, suggesting a systematic blind spot in current databases rather than a tooling artefact.
questions.expected_test: Quantify the fraction of cluster representatives below the curated-reference identity threshold across the full 5.7M-run search; compare cluster count to the size of curated RdRP reference families.
